Name: Menahem, King of Israel
Summary: Menahem, son of Gadi, slew Shallum, cruelly smote Tiphsah, and bought off Pul king of Assyria with a thousand talents exacted from Israel's wealthy men.
KeyStory: Menahem buys off Assyria with Israel's silver.
RelatedPeople: Shallum, King of Israel; Tiglath-Pileser, King of Assyria; Gadi, Father of Menahem; Pekahiah, King of Israel
LifeLesson: Buying peace with tribute only rents the peace and mortgages the people.
